REGISTRATION
Registration is required to operate any OHV on public lands. North
Dakota residents must register through the ND Dept. of Transportation.
Non-residents must purchase a non-resident public trails and lands
access permit. Permits can be purchased at any North Dakota state
park, by phone at 701-328-5357 or online at reserveNDparks.com.
TRAIL RULES
1. Individuals under age 12 may not operate OHVs on public lands.
2. OHV safety certification card required for operators ages 12-15.
3. Helmets required for operators and passengers age 17 and under.
4. Must have functioning spark arrestor and exhaust.
5. All OHV use is restricted to designated areas and trails.
6. Driver must obey all posted signs and traffic regulations.
7. Operator must be able to provide proof of liability insurance.
